newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT 3.3 PCT UP IN JUNE.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT 3.3 PCT UP IN JUNE.

text.p: Romania's industrial output
rose by 3.3 percent in June after two months of decline, on the
strength of rises in the manufacturing sector, the National
Statistics Board (CNS) said on Tuesday.
It said the durable goods sector underwent the steepest
recovery in June with output rising by 35.2 percent from May.
Manufacturing industry went up by 4.6 percent last month,
but output in the power and extractive sectors fell by three
percent and one percent respectively.
Industrial output was 13.77 trillion lei in June, with the
six-month figure at 71.25 trillion lei, 3.6 percent up from the
equivalent period in 1996, CNS data showed.
Inventories accounted for 68.3 percent of June production,
up from 66.3 percent the previous month, with textiles and
timber registring the highest levels.
End-June inventories were 13.2 percent of six-month output,
compared with 13 percent in the year ago period.
Some 21 percent of January-June output went to export, up
from about 20 percent in the year ago period.
Industry employed 5.5 million people at end-June, 28,100
less than the previous month.
